issue_context.title: Optimize the usage of the bind cache
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Now we use the map as the bind records' cache. But it's dangerous when there are so many bindRecords. It may cause OOM. So we try to optimize it. The specific work items are as follows:
* Support the LRU cache
- [ ] Use the LRU to manage the bind Records' cache
- [ ] Support `show binding_cache status' to show the information about the bindCache.
* Enable/ Disable the binding
- [ ] Support `set binding enable/ disable for <stmt> {using <stmt>}`
* Telemetry
- [ ] Support the telemetry for the ``auto capture

review_comments: Please add some test cases for `HintIgnoreIndex`.
Besides, if some hints can not work should we store them? For example, if we use the `HintLimitToCop`, but there is no limit or the limit can not be pushed down.

Yes, theoretically speaking, we shouldn't keep `HintLimitToCop` in this case, but it's not easy to implement it correctly and simply over the current codebase. So I tend to keep `HintLimitToCop` now for safety and leave this as a further optimization.
